## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Kinematics — derived functions for IKinematic2D and IKinematic3D
//
// Bodies for the `IKinematic2D` and `IKinematic3D` interfaces declared in
// `kinematics.concepts.plato`. A motion is sampled by `PositionAt` (meters) and
// `VelocityAt` (meters per second) at a `Duration` since the motion's start;
// the helpers derive speed, displacement, chord distance, the averages over a
// time span, and a rest test. Pure expressions only; all inputs are immutable
// and evaluation is side-effect free. See `README.md` for naming and unit
// conventions.

library Kinematics
{
    //==
    // # IKinematic2D
    //
    // A planar motion sampled by PositionAt (meters) and VelocityAt (meters per
    // second). Times are Durations since the motion's start.

    // The scalar speed at a time: the velocity's magnitude, in meters per second.
    SpeedAt(self: IKinematic2D, time: Duration): Number
        => self.VelocityAt(time).Magnitude;

    // The straight-line displacement from the earlier to the later time.
    DisplacementBetween(self: IKinematic2D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Vector2D
        => self.PositionAt(earlier).Between(self.PositionAt(later));

    // The straight-line distance covered between the two times (chord length).
    DistanceBetween(self: IKinematic2D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Number
        => self.PositionAt(earlier).Between(self.PositionAt(later)).Magnitude;

    // The average velocity over [earlier, later]: displacement over elapsed
    // seconds. Precondition: earlier and later differ.
    AverageVelocityBetween(self: IKinematic2D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Vector2D
        => self.PositionAt(earlier).Between(self.PositionAt(later)) / (later.Seconds - earlier.Seconds);

    // The average speed over [earlier, later]: chord distance over elapsed
    // seconds. Precondition: earlier and later differ.
    AverageSpeedBetween(self: IKinematic2D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Number
        => self.DistanceBetween(earlier, later) / (later.Seconds - earlier.Seconds);

    // True when the body is (nearly) at rest at a time, within the given
    // non-negative speed tolerance.
    IsStationaryAt(self: IKinematic2D, time: Duration, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.VelocityAt(time).Magnitude <= tolerance;

    //==
    // # IKinematic3D
    //
    // A spatial motion; mirrors the planar speed, displacement, and rest helpers.

    // The scalar speed at a time: the velocity's magnitude, in meters per second.
    SpeedAt(self: IKinematic3D, time: Duration): Number
        => self.VelocityAt(time).Magnitude;

    // The straight-line displacement from the earlier to the later time.
    DisplacementBetween(self: IKinematic3D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Vector3D
        => self.PositionAt(earlier).Between(self.PositionAt(later));

    // The straight-line distance covered between the two times (chord length).
    DistanceBetween(self: IKinematic3D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Number
        => self.PositionAt(earlier).Between(self.PositionAt(later)).Magnitude;

    // The average velocity over [earlier, later]: displacement over elapsed
    // seconds. Precondition: earlier and later differ.
    AverageVelocityBetween(self: IKinematic3D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Vector3D
        => self.PositionAt(earlier).Between(self.PositionAt(later)) / (later.Seconds - earlier.Seconds);

    // The average speed over [earlier, later]: chord distance over elapsed
    // seconds. Precondition: earlier and later differ.
    AverageSpeedBetween(self: IKinematic3D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Number
        => self.DistanceBetween(earlier, later) / (later.Seconds - earlier.Seconds);

    // True when the body is (nearly) at rest at a time, within the given
    // non-negative speed tolerance.
    IsStationaryAt(self: IKinematic3D, time: Duration, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.VelocityAt(time).Magnitude <= tolerance;

    //==
    // # The IInterpolatable fills
    //
    // Component-wise blending of motion states. This is a blend of STATES, not
    // an integration of the motion: interpolating a position and a velocity
    // independently gives a state whose velocity is generally not the derivative
    // of its position. That is the right operation for cross-fading two captured
    // states or blending two solver results, and the wrong one for advancing a
    // simulation, which is what `PositionAt` and its family are for.
    // t is unclamped throughout.

    // Position, velocity and acceleration blended independently.
    Lerp(a: KinematicState2D, b: KinematicState2D, t: Number): KinematicState2D
        => (a.Position.Lerp(b.Position, t),
            a.Velocity.Lerp(b.Velocity, t),
            a.Acceleration.Lerp(b.Acceleration, t));

    // Position, velocity and acceleration blended independently.
    Lerp(a: KinematicState3D, b: KinematicState3D, t: Number): KinematicState3D
        => (a.Position.Lerp(b.Position, t),
            a.Velocity.Lerp(b.Velocity, t),
            a.Acceleration.Lerp(b.Acceleration, t));

    // The twist blended part-wise: linear velocity and angular rate.
    Lerp(a: SpatialVelocity2D, b: SpatialVelocity2D, t: Number): SpatialVelocity2D
        => (a.Linear.Lerp(b.Linear, t), a.Angular.Lerp(b.Angular, t));

    // The twist blended part-wise.
    Lerp(a: SpatialVelocity3D, b: SpatialVelocity3D, t: Number): SpatialVelocity3D
        => (a.Linear.Lerp(b.Linear, t), a.Angular.Lerp(b.Angular, t));

    // The wrench blended part-wise: force and torque.
    Lerp(a: SpatialForce2D, b: SpatialForce2D, t: Number): SpatialForce2D
        => (a.Force.Lerp(b.Force, t), a.Torque.Lerp(b.Torque, t));

    // The wrench blended part-wise.
    Lerp(a: SpatialForce3D, b: SpatialForce3D, t: Number): SpatialForce3D
        => (a.Force.Lerp(b.Force, t), a.Torque.Lerp(b.Torque, t));
}
```
